title: ERC-8004 registration and wallet binding
summary: An owner publishes a registration file, mints an agent identity, writes the new agentId back into the file, proves control of a service domain, and binds a separate payment wallet with an EIP-712 signature. No money moves at any step.

steps.label: Publish registration file
steps.detail: The owner writes the registration file (type, name, description, image, services, x402Support, active, registrations, supportedTrust) and hosts it on IPFS or HTTPS, or encodes it as a base64 data URI to keep it on-chain. The registries never fetch this file.

specRef.section: Agent URI and Agent Registration File

failures.condition: The file is unreachable or not valid JSON
failures.outcome: Nothing fails on-chain; explorers and clients mark the agent as unreachable or invalid.

steps.label: register(agentURI)
steps.detail: The owner calls one of the three register overloads. The registry mints the next agentId to msg.sender and sets the reserved agentWallet key to msg.sender. The deployed code starts counting at 0.

failures.condition: The metadata array uses the key agentWallet

steps.label: Return events Transfer, MetadataUpdate, Registered, MetadataSet
steps.detail: A deployed registration with a URI logs Transfer, MetadataUpdate (ERC-4906, only when a URI is set), Registered(agentId, agentURI, owner), then MetadataSet for agentWallet (the owner address) and one MetadataSet per extra entry. The specification lists these events but does not fix their order. The owner reads the new agentId from the Registered log.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25 (log order of the deployed contracts 2.0.0).
Transfer(from=0x0, to=0x0E0E...0E0E, tokenId=123456789)
MetadataUpdate(tokenId=123456789)
Registered(agentId=123456789, agentURI="ipfs://bafy...agent", owner=0x0E0E...0E0E)
MetadataSet(agentId=123456789, metadataKey="agentWallet", metadataValue=0x0E0E...0E0E)

steps.label: Write agentId into registrations
steps.detail: Because the id is known only after minting, the owner adds a registrations entry that names the agentId and the agentRegistry string, and publishes the new file.

steps.label: setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)
steps.detail: With a content-addressed file the URI changes, so the owner points the token at the new file. The deployed registry emits MetadataUpdate (ERC-4906) and then URIUpdated(agentId, newURI, updatedBy).

failures.condition: The caller is neither owner nor operator

steps.label: Serve /.well-known/agent-registration.json
steps.detail: Optional. For each HTTPS service domain that differs from the domain serving the file, the owner publishes a registrations list there. A reader may treat the domain as verified when an entry matches agentRegistry and agentId.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
GET /.well-known/agent-registration.json HTTP/1.1
Host: mcp.agent.example

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{ "registrations": [ { "agentId": 123456789, "agentRegistry": "eip155:1:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432" } ] }

steps.label: Ask the new wallet to sign AgentWalletSet
steps.detail: To receive payments at another address, the owner asks that wallet to sign EIP-712 typed data AgentWalletSet(agentId, newWallet, owner, deadline) under the domain ERC8004IdentityRegistry, version 1. The reference code accepts a deadline at most 5 minutes ahead. For a smart contract wallet, the registry later checks the signature through the wallet's ERC-1271 isValidSignature.

steps.label: Return signature
steps.detail: The wallet returns a 65-byte ECDSA signature, or for a contract wallet a signature its own ERC-1271 check accepts.

steps.label: setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)
steps.detail: The registry checks the deadline window, recovers the signer with ECDSA (covering EIP-7702 delegated accounts) or falls back to ERC-1271, and stores the wallet.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25, contracts 2.0.0.
IdentityRegistry(0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432).setAgentWallet(123456789, 0xB0B0...0B0B, 1791720240, signature)

failures.condition: The deadline is more than 5 minutes ahead
Neither ECDSA nor ERC-1271 validates the signature

steps.label: Return MetadataSet(agentWallet)
steps.detail: The registry emits MetadataSet for agentWallet with the new address. Payers read it with getAgentWallet(agentId). A later token transfer clears it.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
MetadataSet(agentId=123456789, metadataKey="agentWallet", metadataValue=0xB0B0...0B0B)
